title: OpenEthics: A Comprehensive Ethical Evaluation of Open-Source Generative Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating performance disparities by comparing model outputs and rejection rates across a high-resource language (English) and a low-resource language (Turkish) using an LLM-as-a-Judge.
Prompt-based generation of text targeting religious groups, evaluated for stereotypes and biases using an LLM-as-a-Judge (Gemini 2.0 Flash) with a Boolean scoring scheme.
Prompt-based generation of text targeting gender, evaluated for stereotypes and biases using an LLM-as-a-Judge (Gemini 2.0 Flash) with a Boolean scoring scheme.
Prompt-based generation of text targeting racial and ethnic groups, evaluated for stereotypes and biases using an LLM-as-a-Judge (Gemini 2.0 Flash) with a Boolean scoring scheme.
Prompt-based generation of text targeting individuals with disabilities, evaluated for stereotypes and biases using an LLM-as-a-Judge (Gemini 2.0 Flash) with a Boolean scoring scheme.
Prompting models with scenarios testing cultural insensitivity and assessing outputs for offensiveness or dismissiveness of cultural differences using an LLM-as-a-Judge.
